scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const cwd=process.cwd();const d=path.join(cwd,'tests');const testsExist=fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>/\.test\.(js|cjs|mjs)$/.test(f)).length>0;if(!testsExist){console.log('No tests found in server/tests - skipping');process.exit(0);}require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test','tests/**/*.test.js'],{stdio:'inherit'});"
